IMAGE PROMPT
A vertical close-up portrait of an original
young woman with long, straight black
hair and full bangs, wearing a glossy red
satin headband across the top of her
head. She wears a red sheer puff-sleeve
top with a small rounded collar over a
pale pink undershirt, with the sleeves
gathered at the shoulders. She sits with
her knees drawn up, partly visible at the
bottom of the frame, with white knee
socks. Her skin is pale and luminous,
with soft rosy blush on the cheeks and
glossy, coral-pink lips. Her expression is
calm and slightly intense, with a direct
gaze toward the camera. Soft, flat studio
lighting against a dusty pink seamless
backdrop, a palette of cherry red, blush
pink, and cream white. Playful, graphic,
and pastel, in the style of a retro-inspired
beauty or fashion editorial.
